plate_findings.evidence: Caption describes multiple interconnected draining tunnels within a keloidal scar; the tunnels are visible in the submental lesion.
Caption describes the tunnels within a keloidal scar, and a large raised keloidal/fibrotic scar is visible.

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 2 panels (A, B). A: Panel A is a real clinical photograph showing chronic interconnected draining sinus tracts within a keloidal scar in the submental region, explicitly attributed in the caption to ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa. [raw subtype: ectopic] B: Panel B is a real clinical photograph showing the same patient's left jawline and submental lesion with interconnected draining tunnels in a keloidal scar, explicitly attributed to ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa. [raw subtype: ectopic]
panels.attribution_text: Nguyen et al. De novo ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa versus classic ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa: A case series and review of the literature.. JAAD case reports 2024. doi:10.1016/j.jdcr.2024.07.041. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 2.
panels.figure_caption: A, De novo ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa presenting as a chronic multiple interconnected draining tunnels within a keloidal scar in the submental region of the face. B, Closer image of lesion along the left jawline extending to the submental region.
in_text_mentions: state over the last 10 to 12 years. Previous treatments included intralesional triamcinolone, oral clindamycin 300 mg BID, and oral doxycycline 100 mg BID. His physical exam was remarkable for a keloidal plaque along the submental area with underlying edema and multiple draining interconnected tunnels (Fig 2). He had no known history of HS.Fig 2A, De novo ectopic hidradenitis suppurativa presenting as a chronic multiple interconnected draining tunnels within a keloidal scar in the submental region of the face. B, Closer image of lesion along the left jawline extending to the submental region.
